name: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo

summary.text: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo was a Spanish Baroque painter. Although he is best known for his religious works, Murillo also produced a considerable number of paintings of contemporary women and children.
summary.title: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo

2450139: Children Eating Grapes and a Melon is a 1645-1650 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in room XIII of the Alte Pinakothek in Munich.
Children Eating Grapes and a Melon
2456003: The Immaculate Conception of Los Venerables or The Immaculate Conception of Soult is an oil painting by the Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo. It was painted c. 1678 and measures 274 cm × 190 cm.
The Immaculate Conception of Los Venerables
2880218: Madonna and Child of the Napkin or Our Lady of the Napkin is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created c. 1666, as part of the altarpiece of the church of the Capuchin monastery in Seville and now in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville.
Madonna and Child of the Napkin
3633626: Children Eating a Tart is a c. 1670-1675 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, measuring 123 by 102 cm and now in the Alte Pinakothek in Munich.
3715943: The Heavenly and Earthly Trinities is an oil painting on canvas of c. 1675–1682 by the Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo in the National Gallery, London. It depicts a young Jesus with the Virgin Mary and Saint Joseph, together with God the Father and the Holy Spirit.
3757652: Two Women at a Window is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created in 1665–1675, now held in the National Gallery of Art in Washington, D.C., measuring 125 by 104 cm.
3918296: Our Lady of the Rosary is an oil on canvas painting of Our Lady of the Rosary by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created c. 1650-1655. It was previously in the El Escorial Monastery and Palacio Real de Madrid and now is held in the Museo del Prado, in Madrid.
Our Lady of the Rosary (Murillo, Madrid)
3947097: Saint Francis Embracing Christ on the Cross or Allegory of Saint Francis' Renunciation of the Material World to Follow Jesus is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created in 1668-1669, now held in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville.
Saint Francis Embracing Christ on the Cross
5289575: The Mater Dolorosa is a painting of the Madonna by the Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo. The work is in oils on canvas and was painted in 1665.
5659824: The Young Beggar is an oil on canvas genre painting by Spanish painter Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, from c. 1645-1650. Also known as The Lice-Ridden Boy due to the figure of a young boy delousing himself in the painting, The Young Beggar is the first known depiction of a street urchin by Murillo.
5792618: The Birth of the Virgin is a 1661 painting by the Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo.
5826757: The Patrician's Dream or The Foundation of Santa Maria Maggiore in Rome I: The Dream of Patrician John is a 1665 oil on canvas painting by Bartolome Murillo. It has been in the Museo del Prado since 1901.
5968484: The Vision of Saint Anthony of Padua is a 1656 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, commissioned by the chapter of Seville Cathedral as the altarpiece for its chapel of Saint Anthony of Padua, where it still hangs. It replaced an altarpiece by Bernardo Simón de Pineda.
The Vision of Saint Anthony of Padua (Murillo)
6025684: Boy with a Dog is an oil on canvas painting executed ca. 1655–1660 by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the Hermitage Museum, in Saint Petersburg, for which it was acquired from the Comte de Choiseul collection in 1772.
6102310: Rebecca and Eleazar is a 1652 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the Prado Museum in Madrid. It shows a scene from chapter 24 of the Book of Genesis.
6120453: Saint Elizabeth of Hungary Curing the Sick is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created in 1672, commissioned by Miguel de Mañara for the church of San Jorge in the Hospital de la Hermandad de la Caridad in Seville, where it still hangs in its original position.
Saint Elizabeth of Hungary Curing the Sick
6120755: Saint Justa and Saint Rufina is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created c. 1666, now held in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville.
9191536: Christ after the Flagellation is an oil on canvas painting by the Spanish artist Murillo, created c. 1670, now in the Krannert Art Museum in Champaign, Illinois, US, to which it was given by Herman C. Krannert and Ellnora Decker Krannert in 1960.
9191539: Christ after the Flagellation is an oil on canvas painting by Murillo, created c. 1665, now in the Museum of Fine Arts Boston, for which it was bought in 1953 via the Ernest Wadsworth Longfellow Fund. The artist also produced a slightly later version of the scene, now in Illinois.
9191554: Christ Healing the Paralytic at the Pool of Bethesda is a 1667-1670 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, depeciting the eponymous miracle of Jesus recounted in the Gospel of John.
Christ Healing the Paralytic at the Pool of Bethesda
9199638: Four Figures on a Step is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created c. 1655–1660, now held in the Kimbell Art Museum, which bought it from the heirs of Charles Russell Feldman in 1984.
9248340: The Christ Child Distributing Bread to Pilgrims is an oil on canvas painting by Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, from 1678. It is held in the Museum of Fine Arts, in Budapest.
The Christ Child Distributing Bread to Pilgrims
9250142: Ecce Homo is an oil on panel painting of the Ecce Homo motif by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created c. 1672-1678, originally commissioned for Seville Cathedral and now held in the El Paso Museum of Art.
9367601: The Liberation of Saint Peter is an oil painting on canvas of 1665–1667 by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, depicting the scene of the liberation of Peter from Acts 12:5–17. It is now in the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg.
9372596: The Vision of Fray Lauterio is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, from c. 1640. It is held in the Fitzwilliam Museum, in Cambridge, to which it was offered by Joseph Prior in 1879.
9395953: Saint Thomas of Villanova Giving Alms is an oil on canvas painting by Murillo, created c. 1668, originally produced for the Capuchin monastery in Seville and now in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville.
Saint Thomas of Villanova Giving Alms
9395954: Saint Thomas of Villanova Healing a Lame Man is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created c. 1675. It is held in the Alte Pinakothek in Munich, having been bought for Maximilian I Joseph of Bavaria by General Sebastiani in Paris in 1815.
Saint Thomas of Villanova Healing a Lame Man
9396638: Holy Family with the Infant Saint John the Baptist is an oil on canvas painting by Spanish artist Murillo, created c. 1668-1670, now held in the Museum of Fine Arts in Budapest.
Holy Family with the Infant Saint John the Baptist (Murillo)
9396767: Saint Anthony with the Christ Child refers to two paintings by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, dating to 1665–1666 and 1668–1669 and both now in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville.
Saint Anthony with the Christ Child (Murillo)
9396803: Saint Francis of Assisi at Prayer is an oil on canvas painting by Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created in c. 1645–1650, now in the Antwerp Cathedral.
Saint Francis of Assisi at Prayer
9396823: Saint John of God Carrying a Sick Man is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created in 1672. It depicts Saint John of God, with a sick man and an angel.
Saint John of God Carrying a Sick Man
9396888: Saint Roderick is a c. 1650-1655 oil on canvas painting of Saint Roderick by Murillo, now in the Gemaldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden. He is shown vested as a priest in a chasuble and a maniple and holding a biretta and a martyr's palm.
9397467: The Angels' Kitchen is a 1646 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, originally produced for a small Franciscan monastery in the artist's native Seville.
11681382: The Martyrdom of Saint Andrew is a 1675-1682 oil on canvas painting by Murillo, now in the Museo del Prado.
11684158: Abraham and the Three Angels is a c. 1670-1674 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the National Gallery of Canada in Ottawa, which bought it in 1948.
11694421: The Good Shepherd is an oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, from c. 1660. It is held in the Prado Museum, in Madrid.
11731707: Joseph and Potiphar's Wife is a 1640–1645 oil on canvas painting by the Spanish artist Murillo, now in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister (Kassel). His later 1660s version of the subject is now in a private collection.
11770877: The Immaculate Conception of El Escorial is a circa 1660–1665 oil religious painting by the Spanish Baroque artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the Museo del Prado in Madrid. Murillo's many artistic depictions of the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin Mary enormously influenced later art.
The Immaculate Conception of El Escorial
11772156: The Little Fruitseller is a c.1670-1675 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, held in the Alte Pinakothek in Munich, to which it was bequeathed in 1768 by Franz Joseph von Dufresne, a Hofkammerrate.
11790316: The Conversion of Saint Paul is a c.1675-1680 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, acquired by Charles IV of Spain and now in the Prado Museum in Madrid.
11821340: The Adoration of the Shepherds is a painting in oils on canvas by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo in the Museo del Prado in Madrid, dating to c. 1650. He also produced a later version of the same subject.
11825956: The Return of the Prodigal Son is a c. 1667-1670 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the National Gallery of Art in Washington, D.C., to which it was given by the Avalon Foundation in 1948.
The Return of the Prodigal Son (Murillo)
12184056: The Flower Girl is a c. 1665-1670 oil on canvas painting by the Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the Dulwich Picture Gallery, in London.
16593003: The Christ Child and the Infant John the Baptist with a Shell or The Holy Children with a Shell is a 1670-1675 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the Prado Museum in Madrid.
The Christ Child and the Infant John the Baptist with a Shell
16627776: The Holy Family with a Little Bird is a c.1650 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, acquired for the Spanish royal collection by Elisabeth Farnese in 1744 and now in the Prado Museum in Madrid. It shows Saint Joseph, the Virgin Mary and the Christ Child.
The Holy Family with a Little Bird
18915626: Portrait of Íñigo Melchor Fernandez de Velasco is an oil on canvas by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, from 1658 to 1659. It is a portrait of Íñigo Melchor de Velasco, constable of Castille.
Portrait of Íñigo Melchor Fernandez de Velasco
20873211: Our Lady of the Rosary or 'Madonna and Child is a 1648-1650 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo. On 24 November 1784 it was bought from the Comte de Vaudreuil for 9,001 livres by Louis XVI and displayed at the Muséum central des arts from 1793 onwards.
Our Lady of the Rosary (Murillo, Paris)
21725156: Rest on the Flight into Egypt is an oil on canvas painting executed c.1665 by the Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo which is now in the Hermitage Museum, St Petersburg, Russia. It depicts the Holy Family, attended by two Cupids, resting during a flight to safety.
Rest on the Flight into Egypt (Murillo)
21729759: Isaac Blessing Jacob is a 1665-1670 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, forming a pair with Jacob's Dream.
22120723: The La Colosal Immaculate Conception is a c. 1645-1655 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo in the Museum of Fine Arts of Seville.
24569472: The Immaculate Conception is an oil on canvas painting made by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo in the year 1670. It belongs to the collection of Museo Soumaya.
27749021: The Apparition of the Virgin to Saint Bernard is an oil on canvas painting by Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, created c. 1655, now held in the Museo del Prado in Madrid.
The Apparition of the Virgin to Saint Bernard (Murillo)
27752264: The Aranjuez Immaculate Conception is a c.1675 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo. It first appears in the written record in 1818, when it was in the royal chapel of San Antonio in the Palacio de Aranjuez in Madrid, after which it is named.
27966311: The Esquilache Immaculate Conception is a 1645–1655 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo. It is held in the Hermitage Museum, in Saint Petersburg.
27968621: The Walpole Immaculate Conception is an oil on canvas painting by Spanish painter Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, from c. 1680. It is named after English politician Robert Walpole, having formed part of his collection at Houghton Hall.
27976022: The Miracle of the Loaves and Fishes is a c. 1667-1682 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the National Galleries of Scotland after being accepted by the UK government in lieu of inheritance tax in 2005. It is a study for a work still in the artist's native Seville.
The Miracle of the Loaves and Fishes (Murillo, Edinburgh)
43543173: Portrait of Diego Ortiz de Zúñiga is an oil on canvas portrait of the Spanish historian, writer and nobleman Diego Ortiz de Zúñiga, measuring 113 cm by 94 cm.
Portrait of Diego Ortiz de Zúñiga
59313692: The Flight into Egypt is an oil on canvas painting by Spanish artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, from c. 1647-1650. It is held at the Detroit Institute of Arts, since 1950.
105525573: The Immaculate Conception of San Vicent is a c. 1640-1645 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, now in the parish church of San Vicente Mártir in Seville.
The Immaculate Conception of San Vicente
106497109: Adoration of the Shepherds is a c. 1668 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, his second surviving work on that subject after a c.1650 version. It is held at the Wallace Collection, in London.
109535214: Moses at the Rock of Horeb, Moses and the Water from the Rock of Horeb, or Moses Striking the Rock, is a 1669–1670 or 1670–1674 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, still in the Hospital de la Caridad in Seville for which it was originally painted. It was restored in 2018.
Moses at the Rock of Horeb
109656918: The Miracle of the Loaves and Fishes is a 1669–1670 or 1670–1674 oil on canvas painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, still in the Hospital de la Caridad in Seville for which it was originally painted, though an earlier study for it now hangs in Edinburgh. It was restored in 2018.
The Miracle of the Loaves and Fishes (Murillo, Seville)
110159901: The Marriage Feast at Cana is a painting by Bartolomé Esteban Murillo. The painting depicts the Marriage at Cana as Christ performs the miracle of turning Water Into Wine.
138797868: Christ on the Cross may refer to one of four oil on canvas paintings by the Spanish Baroque artist Bartolomé Esteban Murillo:
